_about: Public-domain Thomas Shepard (1605-1649, first pastor of the First Church, Cambridge, Massachusetts) for the Word Hoard. The Works (Boston: Doctrinal Tract and Book Society, 1853, ed. John A. Albro, 3 vols): vol. I clean from CCEL (Life, The Sincere Convert, The Sound Believer and shorter pieces), vols. II-III raw Internet Archive OCR (volume numbers read off the title pages). Also CCEL's The Change of the Sabbath, the Autobiography (1832) and The Clear Sun-shine of the Gospel (1865 reprint). Not Thomas Shepard Goodwin or Thomas G. Shepard. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
